task_text: Spring gate switchyard: A low-friction puck slides inside a U-shaped pen of bouncy rails that is open toward the right arm, and a spring-loaded swinging gate stands inside the pen. The left Panda has a bare gripper. It must take hold of the gate's handle (the block on the gate's free end) with both fingers, swing the gate open one way, and keep holding the handle with the gate well open whenever a later phase is judged. The right Panda's paddle must then hit the puck so that it travels deep into the pen. While the puck runs round, the left hand, still gripping, must swing the gate the other way: at the moment the puck hits the upper (+y) rail, the gate must be at that opposite angle. The right paddle then intercepts the puck. Finally the puck must cross a goal line in front of a backstop on the right arm's side while the left hand still holds the handle with the gate deflected well away from its rest position and the paddle is not touching the puck. Phases, in order: left_gate_open: The gate is held by its handle (both fingers of panda-0, each counting together with its pad, touch the gate's swinging part, and at that physics step each finger's contact points that lie on the handle block, within 2 mm of it, carry a summed impulse above 1e-7 N s) while its angle q exceeds 0.5 rad. q is 0 at the spring's rest orientation and positive when the free end swings toward +x (counter-clockwise seen from above).; right_loop_shot: The puck touches the right paddle at a moment when the gate is held by its handle (as in left_gate_open) with |q| > 0.3 rad; a touch without that does not count, and touches before this phase do not count. After that, at a step where the puck's centre is at world x < -0.05 and the puck does not touch the right paddle, the gate is again held by its handle with |q| > 0.3 rad.; gate_reconfiguration: The puck touches the upper rail (the rail on the +y side of the pen) at a moment when the gate is held by its handle and its angle q is below -0.35 rad.; return_interception: The puck touches the right paddle at a moment when the gate is held by its handle with |q| > 0.3 rad (`intercept_min_speed` = 0 at this instance, so the puck's speed just before is not checked).; final_gate_shot: The puck's centre crosses x = 0.43 moving in +x, with |y - 0.15| < 0.055 m. Moving in +x means x was <= 0.43 on the previous physics step and is > 0.43 now. At that moment the puck must not touch the right paddle, and the gate must be held by its handle with |q| > 0.3 rad. This completes the task. Goal geometry: Goal line for the puck's centre: x = 0.43, crossed in +x with |y - 0.15| < 0.055 m. It. Loop line: the puck's centre must get to x < -0.05. Gate angle thresholds: q > 0.5 rad, q < -0.35 rad and |q| > 0.3 rad.
